name: Rematch: Season 5 - Blue Lock
summary:
Rematch × Blue Lock is out now!

New Limited-Time Mode
Jump into Aura Striker, our new limited-time 3V3 game mode. Activate your Aura to temporarily boost your movement speed and shot power. Adapt, seize the momentum, and make every opportunity count!

Free Rewards for Every Player
Head to the store and claim your free Blue Lock Welcome Bundle. You can also progress through the free Event Pass by completing challenges across Aura Striker, Casual, and Ranked, and unlock Blue Lock-inspired cosmetics along the way.

Step into the World of Blue Lock
Take to the pitch with cosmetic bundles inspired by four iconic Blue Lock characters:
Yoichi Isagi
Meguru Bachira
Seishiro Nagi
Rin Itoshi
Each bundle includes a character-inspired skin, a unique goal celebration, and profile cosmetics.

Let's go, diamonds in the rough. Time for aura farming.
